instruction: Cinematic video still, medium shot. Inside an indoor boxing gym ring, the woman in the black and orange athletic suit (R1) stands on the left facing right, holding a red focus mitt. The woman in the white sports bra (R2) stands on the right facing left, her back partially to the camera, extending her left arm to strike the mitt with her black glove. Cool overhead lighting highlights their athletic forms against the dark background of hanging punching bags.

R2 extends her left arm to punch the mitt with a black glove
R1 is the mitt holder while R2 is the striker
